patch_description: Current algorithm sends num_partitions copies along the single Dijkstra shortest path to each dst, causing redundant transfers. Improvement: for each partition, use a distinct k-shortest path (nx.shortest_simple_paths) so parallel network links are used and load is spread. Also, partition-level routing via a shared relay tree reduces cost: instead of sending each partition per dst independently, send each partition once to a "relay" node that is closest (cost-wise) to all destinations, then fan out from the relay. Concretely, for each partition j, compute a shortest path from src to a relay (chosen as the node minimizing sum of costs to dsts, approximated via multi-destination Dijkstra), and from the relay compute shortest paths to each dst. This reduces redundant transfers because the src->relay segment is shared across all destinations for that partition. This is a targeted change to search_algorithm.
